prompt: Use case: precise face-medium edit with identity preservation. Create a vertical 9:16 hand-painted pet portrait at exactly 720x1280 pixels from exactly three input images. Image 1 is the edit target. Preserve its exact composition, half-body pose, body proportions, orange field, teal and coral accents, dry-brushed body, scraped pigment, negative space and all paint outside the head. The body and background already work; do not redesign them. Image 2 is the authoritative hand-painted face-medium reference. Repaint the complete head and facial area of Image 1 with the same rough dry-brush language: broad broken bristle strokes, scraped pigment, flat colour masses, exposed underpainting, simplified dark gestural lines and intentionally incomplete edges. The face, ears and neck must visibly belong to the same physical painting as the body. Reconstruct both yellow-green eyes as flat illustrated almond-shaped pigment patches bounded by imperfect charcoal brush lines. Use only two or three flat colour values per eye and a simple black vertical pupil. Use no white catchlight, no reflected window, no gradient, no translucency, no wetness and no glass depth. Visible bristle gaps and uneven painted edges must cross the eye shapes so they unmistakably read as paint on canvas. Reconstruct the pink-brown nose as one simplified matte coral-and-charcoal painted shape with rough dry-brush edges, no pores, no gradient and no shine. Build the muzzle, closed mouth, cheek stripes and forehead M from broad broken dry-brush marks. Reduce the cheek and brow fur to chunky directional paint groups. Use only a few gestural charcoal whisker lines with broken pigment texture, never clean camera-sharp white hairs. Image 3 is identity-only. Preserve the same Dragon Li cat's brown-grey mackerel tabby pattern, forehead M, cheek stripes, yellow-green eyes, pink-brown nose, upright ears and rounded youthful face. Do not import Image 3's photographic lighting, individual hairs, lens sharpness, smooth shading or glossy surfaces. Keep the expression warm, calm and lovable. Blend the repainted head naturally into the already painted chest and background, allowing some edge strokes to dissolve into orange and teal. Reject eye catchlights, reflected windows, glass depth, photoreal eyes, photographic nose, camera-resolved whiskers or fur, smooth airbrush realism, cut-out face, 3D rendering, text, logo, watermark or signature.
